members.hook: Zhavoronkov built Insilico Medicine to prove that generative AI could do more than analyze biology, it could design new drug candidates outright, and Rentosertib, discovered and designed by Insilico's AI pipeline, became one of the first such molecules to reach human clinical trials.
members.name: Alex Zhavoronkov

members.hook: Germanidis co-founded the generative-video company Runway in 2018 and served as its CTO for over seven years before becoming Co-CEO in 2026. Before Runway he worked in machine learning and computer vision at IBM Research and as a backend engineer at Zocdoc, Chartbeat, and Quantcast.
members.name: Anastasis Germanidis

members.hook: Gilman's brand philosophy, that the best brands make people feel something real, was forged across twenty-five years of payments and fintech marketing where the product is inherently invisible. She helped grow Zelle past a trillion dollars in transactions and launched Paze from scratch to a David Ogilvy Silver Award. Her public view on AI is clear: it is a tool for freeing humans to do what humans do best, and trust, judgment, and creativity remain at the heart of great brands.
members.name: Andrea Gilman
members.moniker: Chief Marketing Officer at Early Warning, Zelle and Paze

members.hook: Ng did more than any single figure to turn machine learning from a graduate-school subject into a skill anyone could learn online, while simultaneously building the industrial-scale infrastructure, Google Brain among it, that made deep learning practical at big-tech scale.
members.name: Andrew Ng
members.moniker: AI Educator and Deep Learning Pioneer

members.hook: Smith turned a $600K loss into an $8 million profit at Piston Group inside a single year, then spent two decades repeating that pattern of operational turnarounds across automotive and manufacturing suppliers ranging from $120 million to over $1 billion in revenue. He now sits on the board of Nikola Motor Company, the autonomous and electric truck maker, while running his own holding company, Voltava.
members.name: Bruce Smith
members.moniker: Owner, Chairman and CEO, Voltava; Nikola Motor Company board member

members.hook: Dolgov has been inside Google and Waymo's self-driving effort from its earliest days as a Google X project through its emergence as the first company to operate paid, fully driverless rides at commercial scale, rising from founding engineer to Co-CEO across that entire arc.
members.name: Dmitri Dolgov

members.hook: Nguyen holds a Stanford PhD combining AI with bioengineering and spent years on deepfake detection at Facebook AI and Adobe before research internships in Fei-Fei Li's and Leonidas Guibas's labs and at Google DeepMind's co-scientist team. He now leads Radical Numerics, a company he co-founded to build what he describes as general biological intelligence.
members.name: Eric Nguyen

members.hook: Suh spent over 23 years at IBM, rising to head global strategic partnerships worth more than $10 billion before leading Watson AI product units in commerce, supply chain and collaboration; she then served as President of DocuSign and on its board through its 2018 IPO before becoming CEO of Niantic Spatial, a company building real-world foundation models for physical AI.
members.name: Inhi Cho Suh

members.hook: Patel has run product at four different points along enterprise software's evolution, content management at Doculabs, cloud file sync at EMC and Syncplicity, cloud content at Box, and now security, collaboration, and AI infrastructure at Cisco, rising to President and Chief Product Officer as the company repositions its networking core around AI.
members.name: Jeetu Patel
members.moniker: President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco

members.hook: Shankel built her career in the operational and technical backbone of the automotive industry, general management, manufacturing processes, market expansion, before moving into the CTO seat at a commercial vehicle manufacturer and then founding her own technology company. Her PhD in organizational leadership combined with hands-on OEM manufacturing experience places her at the intersection of people-driven transformation and industrial technology adoption.
members.name: Kelleigh Shankel

members.hook: Gelsinger's career traces the arc of modern computing hardware itself: chief architect of a landmark Intel processor in his twenties, the company's first CTO, then, decades later, recalled as CEO to fight for American chip manufacturing leadership just as AI's compute demands made semiconductors a national priority.
members.name: Pat Gelsinger
members.moniker: Engineer Who Led Intel's Turnaround Attempt

members.hook: Solomon's path from electrical engineering to venture investment to AI partnerships at Airbus traces the evolution of applied AI from semiconductor and IoT adjacencies into aerospace's core technology strategy. At Airbus she shapes the partnerships and technology decisions that will determine how autonomous systems, AI-assisted design, and intelligent maintenance enter one of the most safety-critical industries in the world.
members.name: Reena Solomon
members.moniker: Head of AI Partnerships at Airbus, North America

members.hook: Altman turned artificial intelligence from a research field into a consumer phenomenon and a geopolitical agenda item. ChatGPT's November 2022 launch under his leadership put generative AI in hundreds of millions of hands, and his Senate testimony six months later, a CEO asking to be regulated, set the tone for the global governance debate this library documents.
members.name: Sam Altman
members.moniker: The Face of the AI Boom

members.hook: Thrun proved autonomous driving was possible by winning DARPA's toughest robotics prize, then built the Google program that turned that proof into Waymo, the industry's leading self-driving company, while separately co-founding Udacity to bring university-grade technical education online.
members.name: Sebastian Thrun
members.moniker: Founder of Google's Self-Driving Car Project and Udacity

members.hook: Latimer trained as a drilling and completion engineer at BHP Billiton before pairing an energy-track master's degree with an MBA at Stanford, then founded Fervo Energy, the enhanced-geothermal company applying oil-and-gas drilling techniques to clean baseload power. He has led the company for nearly nine years and was named a Presidential Leadership Scholar in 2022.
members.name: Tim Latimer

members.hook: O'Reilly has spent four decades doing the same thing under different names: spotting a technology shift before the industry has language for it, then naming it. 'Open source' and 'Web 2.0' both trace to conferences he convened, and his publishing house has been the technical-literacy backbone for the programmers who built the modern internet, and now AI.
members.name: Tim O'Reilly
members.moniker: Publisher Who Named Web 2.0 and the Open Source Movement

members.hook: Gruber built a career in academic knowledge-representation research before co-founding Siri, whose acquisition by Apple in 2010 put conversational AI into hundreds of millions of pockets years before ChatGPT made the category mainstream, and he has argued ever since for AI designed to amplify human intelligence rather than substitute for it.
members.name: Tom Gruber
